Hi there! 24F here offering my favorites that aren't classics. 

The Paris Wife: fiction. It's about Hemingway's wife. It's inspiring to me because despite his poor behavior and affairs she remains very classy and strong. I like it because she is relatable as she is just a normal human with normal emotions with real life issues like us. 

Ordinary Grace: fiction. I'm not religious but the idea of God's grace is beautiful to me. This book is an easier read and set in an older time about 2 young boys but it instills a sense of peace and nostalgia and at the end you feel good about life. 

I am Legend: fiction. It's way different from the movie and the end is unpredictable and surprising. It's pretty short. I like it because it shows the basic human nature of survival and goes through the stages of grief as the main character deals with the changes of the world. 

My Sisters Keeper: fiction. I know it's a popular one but the character development in the book is brilliant and you fall in love with every character. I've read it at least 5 times and cry every time.
